title: WireRecord
description: Product reliability records only. No record authenticates a caller, grants approval or proves business execution. Standard ACP/A2UI schemas retain their upstream owners.

Id.description: Opaque ASCII correlation identifier (1–128 characters); never an authentication credential.

Counter.description: Nonnegative integer in the shared JavaScript safe-integer range.

sessionId.description: Logical session identifier, never reusable after retirement.

Namespace.description: Trusted tenant/principal/authority/logical-session storage scope supplied by authenticated ingress.

id.description: Configuration identifier; resolve credentials outside the wire.

revision.description: Immutable configuration revision; changing it invalidates prior capability evidence.

ConfigRef.description: Immutable configuration identity and revision; contains no credentials.

adapterVersion.description: Adapter implementation version used for capability verification.

generation.description: Live provider incarnation token; rejects callbacks from previous incarnations.

nativeSessionId.description: Provider-owned context session identifier; history alone cannot recreate it.

config.description: Exact immutable configuration identity and revision.

nativeRunId.description: Provider-owned model-turn/run identifier, required when the provider exposes it.

nativeRequestId.description: Provider-owned parent prompt/query request identifier; cannot be rebound after dispatch. Callback identities belong to Interaction.

workspaceId.description: SHA-256 identity of the normalized absolute workspace path. Filesystem containment remains owned by the provider adapter and composition root.

nativeThreadId.description: Provider-owned thread identity within the native session tree; required when the provider exposes distinct threads.

Binding.description: Provider context identity. Version, configuration, account and generation bind every capability and callback.

CapabilityState.description: Only supported enables an operation; unknown and unsupported fail closed.

continuation.description: same_process resumes only a live context; across_processes requires verified provider restoration; unsupported/unknown cannot resume.

cancellation.description: request_only confirms sending; terminal_acknowledged requires native terminal evidence; unsupported/unknown cannot promise cancellation.

tools.description: host_mediated still requires containment evidence; provider_managed is not controlled execution; disabled/unknown cannot enable tools.

steer.description: Whether an active native run accepts targeted steering.

fork.description: Whether the provider supports an explicit context fork.

subagent.description: Whether the provider supports child agents; not execution authorization.

terminal.description: Whether the provider exposes a terminal facility; not the command terminal state.

structuredQuestion.description: Whether a native structured callback can be represented and answered.

multimodal.description: Whether provider-specific multimodal input is available through an adapter extension.

Capabilities.description: Capabilities established for one exact provider binding, never execution authorization.

Outcome.description: Definite model-turn outcome; does not establish process exit or business-side-effect completion.

ErrorCode.description: Closed value-free error category; diagnostics never include model text or credentials.

Retry.description: same_command preserves identity/content; reconcile_first checks the original operation; never forbids retry.

code.description: Closed diagnostic category without input values.

retry.description: Explicit retry discipline; uncertainty never authorizes blind resubmission.

Failure.description: Value-free failure and explicit retry discipline.

text.description: Untrusted model/user text subject to the whole-envelope budgets.

policy.description: queue_next serializes later work; steer must match the currently active native run.

targetRunId.description: Exact active native run required for steer; forbidden for queue_next.

oneOf.description: prompt variant; all fields are data, never authentication or execution authority.

ContextStage.description: One provider context phase. Native generations may change only through verified recovery; binding is owned here.

oneOf.description: An explicit endpoint and model using a native secure credential reference.
Explicit API settings read from a private existing CLI configuration.

Connection.description: A user-owned named provider connection with immutable configuration and credential revisions; contains opaque references, never secrets.

UserPreferences.description: Independent optional selections owned by the current test user.

TestUser.description: TestUser product wire record; validated against the V5 schema.

UserContext.description: UserContext product wire record; validated against the V5 schema.

HistoryPreview.description: Explicit plain-text transcript preview bound to a target connection revision and frozen history watermark.

NativeControlFrame.description: Private inherited Native-to-Host control frame. The descriptor is the trust boundary; this record only closes framing and payload shape.

ExecutionOrigin.description: Non-secret AI operation provenance carried only on the desktop-owned execution pipe.

PreferencesPatch.description: Missing fields remain unchanged; set replaces and clear removes one preference atomically.
